newsitem.title: USA: Kmart Corp Q4 Jan 29 loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: Kmart Corp Q4 Jan 29 loss narrows.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1996 Q4 loss includes loss from disposal of discontinued operations of $385 million, or $0.69 a share, plus operating loss from discontinued operations of $14 million, or $0.03 a share.
1996 Q4 also includes pre-tax gain of $108 million from sale of Rite-Aid common stock, and pre-tax charge of $98 million to write down the value of its international operation.
1996 Q4 net profit from continuing operations was $235 million, or $0.45 a share, versus loss $118 million, or $0.26 a share.
Excluding a non-cash accounting charge of $150 million, or $0.33 a share, Q4 1995 operating profit was $32 million, or $0.07 a share, from continuing retail operations.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1996 year loss includes loss from discontinued operations of $451 million, or $0.93 per primary share versus loss of $290 million, or $0.63 a share.
1995 year loss also includes Q4 accounting charge of $150 million plus charge of $51 million, or $0.11 a share, for debt restructuring.

Excluding all discontinued operations and extraordinary charges, Kmart earned $231 million, or $0.48 per primary share from continuing operations in 1996 vs continuing operations loss of $230 million, or $0.51 a share.
